commencement_date.span: June 29, 2021 — Eaton Vance Short Duration Diversified Income Fund (NYSE: EVG), Eaton Vance Floating-Rate Income Trust (NYSE: EFT), Eaton Vance Senior Floating-Rate Trust (NYSE: EFR) and Eaton Vance Senior Income Trust (NYSE: EVF) (each, a “Fund” and collectively, the “Funds”) each announced today the commencement of a cash tender offer

expiration_date.span: The Offer expires on July 30, 2021 at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, unless the Fund extends the Offer.

proration.span: If more Shares than the Offer Amount are properly tendered and not withdrawn prior to the date the Offer expires, the Fund will purchase the Offer Amount on a pro rata basis (disregarding fractional shares).

trigger_origin.span: In connection with the Transaction, Fund shareholders were asked to approve a new investment advisory agreement with EVM (the “New Agreement”) in order to maintain the continuity of the Fund’s operations. As announced on March 9, 2021, the Board approved the Offer, conditioned on Fund shareholders approving the New Agreement.

notes: Original Schedule TO-I (offer document) for an issuer cash tender for common shares at 99% of NAV. trigger_origin: the filing says that on March 1, 2021 Morgan Stanley acquired Eaton Vance Corp. (the adviser's parent; 'the Transaction'), shareholders were asked to approve a new advisory agreement in connection with it, and the Board approved the Offer conditioned on that approval (approved May 7, 2021; 'the condition was met'). Coded merger_related (adviser-level M&A, not a fund merger); board_discretionary is the alternative reading. No standstill or activist agreement is mentioned in this filing. The met shareholder-approval condition is excluded from conditions because it was already satisfied. conditions element 'other' is the asset-coverage condition for senior securities; market_disruption also covers the banking-moratorium and credit-limitation clauses in the same Section 13. commencement_date from the joint press release (June 29, 2021, 'announced today the commencement'); the Offer to Purchase is also dated June 29, 2021. Expiration: July 30, 2021, 5:00 p.m. Eastern, unless extended (only one date stated). Inconsistency in the filing: the Summary Term Sheet gives the June 23, 2021 NAV as $13.6727 and the closing price as $13.24, but the Introduction and Section 1 call $13.24 the NAV; the fee calculation uses $13.5360 = 99% of $13.6727. 17,880,596 Shares outstanding as of June 23, 2021. The joint press release also describes Conditional Tender Offers for EFT, EFR and EVF (not EVG); not extracted here as they do not concern this filer.
